content:
incident-bot: PAGER -> @eng-runtime-oncall: spike in 500s for customer Velox. Error traces point to routing policy falling back to an incompatible model variant.

Alice Chen: seeing embed->gen mismatch in the logs. Customers calling embeddings endpoint but routed to gen-instruct:v2.

Bob Patel: confirmed. Example request ID: req_8f7a2c - headers say 'endpoint: embeddings', but route resolved to model 'rwv-instruct-3b:v2/variant=gen'.

Carol Nguyen: escalate flag: high impact for 3 enterprise seats (Velox, NovaAnalytics, FinX) - embedding jobs returning malformed vectors (length mismatch).

Dan Morales: attaching recent routing-policy snapshot:```json
{
  "policy_id": "smart-route-2026-04",
  "rules": [
    {"match": {"endpoint":"embeddings","region":"us-east-1"}, "target": "rwv-embed-3b:v1"},
    {"match": {"endpoint":"chat","customer_tier":"enterprise"}, "target": "rwv-chat-7b:v3"},
    {"match": {"pinned_version":"rwv-instruct-3b:v2"}, "fallback": true}
  ]
}
```Note: the pinned_version rule above is too generic and seems to be matching across endpoints.

Eve Roberts: runtime logs show fallback chain: rwv-embed-3b -> not available -> pinned rwv-instruct-3b:v2 -> runtime attempted to serve rwv-instruct-3b with variant 'instruct' but fallback mapping produced variant 'gen' on the host.

eng-runtime-oncall: I'm taking it. Initial mitigation: lock routing policy to explicit mapping for embeddings in us-east-1 and disable generic pinned_version fallback. Will apply a quick route override.

Alice Chen: please confirm impact window and number of failed requests.

eng-runtime-oncall: full query count: ~12k requests in last 8 minutes; failed ~9.6k with 5xx and malformed responses. Affected customers: Velox (~48% of failures), NovaAnalytics (~30%), others ~22%.

Bob Patel: creating a temporary override:```yaml
- id: override-embeddings-us-east-2026-04-01
  match:
    endpoint: embeddings
    region: us-east-1
  target: rwv-embed-3b:v1
  ttl: 3600
```Applying now via /admin/routing/overrides API.

eng-runtime-oncall: applied override. Also toggled pinned-version fallback to `off` for smart-route-2026-04.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: rollout of override completed (commit c3a9f2).

Carol Nguyen: can we do a quick smoke for Velox?

eng-runtime-oncall: pinged Velox tenant, running sample embedding batch -> responses now consistent length 768 vectors, no 5xx.

Dan Morales: thanks. Which component introduced the variant mismatch? We need a root cause before lifting the override.

Eve Roberts: preliminary: the policy translator service (policy-translator v1.14) had a regression where pinned_version rules lost endpoint scoping when generating host routing keys. I see a PR that added global pinning semantics last week.

Bob Patel: PR link: https://git.redwood/policy-translator/pulls/289 - adds support for model pin fallback. Author: dan.morales. The change didn't propagate endpoint constraints into the compiled rule.

Dan Morales: yep that was me. I pushed the change to support cross-model pin fallback for multi-variant deployments. I didn't add explicit endpoint-bound tests. Sorry — I'll revert the consumer-facing behavior.

Alice Chen: immediate next steps?

eng-runtime-oncall: 1) Keep override live until patch lands and is validated. 2) Roll back policy-translator change from prod to staging for further tests. 3) Add unit+integration test ensuring pinned_version rules carry match scope (endpoint, region, customer). 4) Notify customers.

Carol Nguyen: notify channel -> I'll draft CC notices for Velox and NovaAnalytics (severity: degraded embeddings correctness). We should offer them re-run credits.

sre-lead: are there any secondary impacts (rate limiting, routing storms)?

Eve Roberts: there was a small routing storm as hosts tried fallbacks in parallel; autoscaler kicked but then stabilized after override. No infra incidents. CPU on some hosts spiked briefly.

Bob Patel: timeline and handoff: I'll coordinate with Dan to revert the PR in policy-translator. Dan, can you make the revert + hotfix and request a canary rollout to staging?

Dan Morales: on it. Reverting PR now and adding scoped tests. ETA 25m for PR and staging canary.

eng-runtime-oncall: handoff to Dan at 1780484000 (10:00 UTC). I'll stay on standby for validation windows.

Alice Chen: when can we notify customers that root cause is identified and a fix is in progress? Need wording for status page.

Carol Nguyen: draft: "We identified a routing policy bug that caused pinned model rules to be applied across endpoints, resulting in embeddings traffic being routed to an incompatible model variant. A temporary route override is in place and a code fix is being deployed. We expect full resolution within 2 hours."

Bob Patel: looks good. Add link to support contact and re-run credits.

incident-bot: slackbot note: @eng-runtime-oncall, please update incident channel when fix is pushed to prod.

Dan Morales: reverted PR and opened hotfix PR #292 with tests. Triggered CI.

eng-runtime-oncall: hotfix merged to main and promoted to canary cluster. Starting validation suite.

Carol Nguyen: updating customers now with the draft and ETA 2 hours.

Eve Roberts: canary validation passed. No regression on other endpoints. Promoting to prod in 5m.

eng-runtime-oncall: rolling hotfix to prod. Monitoring telemetry.

Bob Patel: once prod is healthy, we'll remove the override (ttl still active but we prefer explicit remove after confidence).

incident-bot: deploy-bot: hotfix rollout completed (deploy id: deploy_prod_1178).

eng-runtime-oncall: metrics: 5xx collapsed to baseline within 3 minutes of deploy. Embedding vector lengths normalized.

Carol Nguyen: customer update: fix deployed, embeddings nominal, offering 3 hours free re-runs. Velox response: thanks, will validate and confirm.

Alice Chen: postmortem actions to assign: Dan - revert PR + tests (done), Bob - add e2e routing test harness for pinned variants (ETA 1 week), Eve - add anomaly alert for cross-endpoint fallback counts (ETA 3 days), Carol - customer remediation communications (complete), SRE - run playbook to harden autoscaler on fallback storms (ETA 2 days).

sre-lead: schedule a follow-up incident review tomorrow 15:00 UTC.

Bob Patel: removing override now via API.```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/routing/overrides/remove \ 
  -d '{"id":"override-embeddings-us-east-2026-04-01"}'
```
override removed.

incident-bot: Incident closed (severity: S2, duration: ~18 minutes of highest impact).

Alice Chen: thanks everyone. We'll collect logs and assemble postmortem. I'll own the doc draft.

Dan Morales: sorry again for the oversight, will follow up with PR link and tests in the postmortem.

Bob Patel: good catch by runtime telemetry. Nice quick mitigation work.

Carol Nguyen: closing thread when postmortem link is attached.

incident-bot: reminder: please add participants to the incident board and tag related repos.

Alice Chen: will do.
